requirements.text: The request contains customerId and one or more lines with sku and positive quantity.
Unknown SKUs and nonpositive quantities are rejected.
A successful request creates a CREATED order, calculates the line-total sum, and emits order.created with the new order identifier.

sources: CreateOrderService validates customer and order lines before saving the order.
The supplied change publishes OrderCreated with the saved order identifier.
